title: Observability: DO_KDF successful dispatch has no provider attribution log
description: ioctl_do_kdf calls crypto2dev_lookup_algo() fresh and dispatches to a provider, but on success never logs which provider was selected. INIT, KEY_IMPORT, and KEY_GENERATE all emit 'dispatched to provider' on success. DO_KDF is the only dispatch path that is silent on success. A support engineer reviewing a ring buffer from a system where DO_KDF produced wrong output or a follow-on INIT failed on key algo mismatch cannot determine from the log which provider ran the KDF. Fix: add pr_info_ratelimited after successful kdf() call, matching the pattern used by ioctl_init and ioctl_key_import.
close_reason: Added pr_info_ratelimited after successful kdf() call, matching the provider attribution pattern used by ioctl_init and ioctl_key_import
